title: Balanced whole-system coefficient composition and identity laws
statement: Fix the whole-system coefficient models of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models] and their scalar adjunctions, with the canonical restriction-composition and restriction-identity maps of [lem-pur-system-scalar-coherence]. Define the scalar associator by uniqueness of left adjoints to the canonical composed restriction adjunction, and the scalar unitor by uniqueness of left adjoints to identity restriction. The coherence-law predicate for a fixed compactification requires that the actual ring-system inclusion maps compose and are identity for identity field extensions. It further requires that, for $E\le F\le L$ and every normalized input, the successive two actual compact-support coefficient comparisons, conjugated by these scalar associators, equal the comparison for $E\le L$ in the ordinary derived category of whole systems; the identity comparison equals the unitor-normalized identity. These are definitions of the comparisons and their law predicate, without an existence assertion.
